title: Struct Memory Alignment & Sizeof Calculations
description:
Understanding memory layout, structure padding, and member ordering is an essential skill in embedded systems where RAM is constrained and hardware registers align to fixed boundaries.

### Requirements:
Implement `get_s1_size()`, `get_s2_size()`, `get_s3_size()`, and `get_s4_size()` returning the `sizeof()` each struct.
hint: Use the `sizeof` operator to calculate total memory size including any alignment padding.
